thread:
Mira: alerting — seeing sustained p95/p99 latency spike on eu-dedicated pool starting ~09:12 UTC, throughput drop on several tenants. dashboards show KV cache eviction storm and kernel fallback churn. investigating now.
SRE Bot: [ALERT] eu-dedicated: latency_p95 x3 above SLO for 10m; affected: pool-eu-3, pool-eu-7.
Dan: copying logs — looks like a sudden increase in small (<64 token) chat requests with long context, causing mis-batched kernels. kernel_selector logs show rapid switches: kernel=optim_attn_v2 -> fallback=generic_attn for same model repeatedly.
Esha: could this be a batching heuristic regression? we deployed batching change yesterday to favor larger groups for GPU util.
Oliver: adding that telemetry: batch_size_histogram shows spike in 1-2 and also a new mode at 128. that bimodal distribution will confuse kernel scoring.
Mira: KV cache metrics: cache_hits dropped from 92% -> 54%; eviction_rate spiked. example eviction log:
```
[2026-02-18T09:13:02Z] kv_evict count=4821 pool=eu-dedicated host=gpu-12 tenant=acct-834 reason=mem_pressure
[2026-02-18T09:13:03Z] kv_evict count=4890 pool=eu-dedicated host=gpu-12 tenant=acct-291 reason=mem_pressure
```
Esha: that explains tail latency — repeated cold KVs inflate token generation cost and kernel paths change due to cache miss size.
Kai: placement info: scheduler shows several noisy tenants pinned to pool-eu-3 due to outdated quota config. a few high-concurrency tenants exceeded expected slot allocation and forced evictions.
Sam (prod-eng): wait — did we apply the new reserved-quota policy to eu region? I thought that was gated. if quota misconfig allowed overcommits, noisy neighbors would be expected.
Dan: confirmed in infra config: quota.topology.europe.dedicated.max_per_tenant was set to 0 (interpreted as unlimited) in a PR that landed yesterday. PR: deploy/infra#879.
Oliver: rolling a hotfix to restore max_per_tenant=8 and pin noisy tenants to separate pools. initiating rollout to pool-eu-3 now.
SRE Bot: [DEPLOY] infra-config 879-hotfix started at 09:31 UTC.
Mira: quick mitigation: enabling aggressive KV prefetch for impacted models and forcing kernel selection policy to prefer stable kernel (optim_attn_v1) for 30m. will that help?
Esha: prefetch + pinning should reduce cold misses. but the batching heuristic still needs work — scoring should be resilient to bimodal request sizes. filing follow-up: perf/bug 2026-128.
Dan: profiling snapshot attached to thread (summaries): kernel_switches/sec jumped from 0.2 -> 12; avg_batch_pack_time up 45%; kv_lookup_latency p99 from 1.2ms -> 9.8ms.
Mira: SLA impact: several customers reported degraded response times; paging oncall for customers over SLO. I'm annotating incident timeline.
Sam (prod-eng): notifying account teams for tenants in pool-eu-3, will coordinate credits if SLA breached.
Oliver: hotfix completed, config rolled back and quotas enforced at 09:40 UTC. metrics trending back toward baseline. please keep monitoring for 60m.
Mira: thanks — postmortem checklist: 1) revert batching heuristic change or add conservative fallback, 2) fix quota default parsing (0 != unlimited), 3) improve KV eviction alerts to correlate with placement/quotas, 4) add kernel-selection stability metric. I'll start the incident writeup. :white_check_mark:
